GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2020-01-02T21:19:41Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: MemoryTracker exception despite unlimited memory setting
Description: Received the following exception multiple times during writes to a node (stack trace at end).

`B::Exception: Memory limit (total) exceeded: would use 74.51 GiB (attempt to allocate chunk of 4217732 bytes), maximum: 74.51 GiB (version 19.17.4.11) `

I can't figure out what memory limit is being exceeded.  (These errors are happening during writes).  The 74.51GiB value is not configured anywhere, and the box itself has 792G of total memory, of which we are only using a small fraction.  The only configured limit on the default profile is per query of 100GiB `max_memory_usage_per_query = 107374182400`.

These errors seem to correspond to large merges; when the merge finally completed the errors cleared up.  Is ClickHouse possibly misreading the total available system memory?
